final_message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now slugs to `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the previously failing accented-letters test.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. Before slugifying, it decomposes the title (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks, so `è` becomes `e` rather than being dropped.

I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say not to edit it by hand. The shop's `src/shop/product-url.js` calls the same vendored slugify directly, so product names with accents will still lose letters. That's out of scope for this fix, but it would need the same treatment, or an upgrade of the vendored library.
